sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that during the pendency of the trial, the parties have settled the matter amicably in terms of the Settlement Deed dated 02.05.2023.
A copy of the said Settlement Deed is placed on record.
Accordingly, the marriage of the petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 was dissolved vide Mubarat Nama/Talaq Mubarat dated 01.06.2023.
The copy of the decree is already on record.
6. Petitioners and Respondent No.2 are present in Court and they have been identified by the IO.
I have interacted with the parties and they submit that they have settled their disputes.
Respondent No.2 admits that she has settled the matter amicably with the petitioners.
She further submits that the settlement/compromise has taken place voluntarily, without any force, pressure or coercion.
As per settlement, today, a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- has been handed over to respondent no.2 in cash.
Respondent No.2 submits that nothing remains to be adjudicated further between them and she has no objection if the FIR in question is quashed.
Statement of respondent no. 2 in this regard has been recorded separately.

Due to some temperamental issues, differences and disputes arose between me and petitioner no.1, thereafter, I started living separately from the petitioner no. 1.
I admit that I have settled the matter amicably with the petitioners voluntarily, without any force, pressure or coercion in terms of the Settlement Deed dated 02.05.2023.
My marriage with the petitioner no. 1 has been dissolved vide Mubarat Nama/Talaq Mubarat dated 01.06.2023.
I have received a sum of Rs. 2,00,000/-, i.e., the total amount of the settlement.
I state that I have no objection if the FIR in question is quashed.
I undertake to abide by my statement made in the Court today.
